item.title: Single Frame Absolute Angle Metrology with Dual Pancharatnam Berry Metasurfaces
item.description:
Communications Physics, Published online: 08 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s42005-026-02831-0

Measuring tiny rotations in compact systems is important for precision manufacturing, but existing methods often trade measurement range for accuracy. Here, the authors show that two Pancharatnam Berry metasurfaces convert rotation into a phase gradient, enabling sign-resolved readout from one hologram over ±11° with 1.98 × 10⁻⁵ rad resolution.

item.title: Coherent Control of Thermal Transport with Pillar-Based Phononic Crystals
item.description:
Communications Physics, Published online: 31 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s42005-026-02774-6

Korkiamäki et al. measure the thermal conductance of nano- and microscale pillared phononic crystals at sub-Kelvin temperatures. They demonstrate up to an order of magnitude reduction, attributed to the coherent modification of the phononic band structure.
